# Config scenario picker

Pick a **scenario** first, then open a representative YAML under `configs/`.

| Scenario | Use when | Representative configs |
|----------|----------|------------------------|
| **Minimal VQE (Path A)** (`minimal_vqe`) | Default H2 sto-3g VQE smoke; start here for Methods/repro export. | `configs/example_h2.yaml`, `configs/profiles/minimal_h2.yaml` |
| **UCCSD + Pauli protocol** (`uccsd_pauli`) | Chemical ansatz with grouped Pauli measurement protocol. | `configs/example_h2_uccsd_pauli_protocol.yaml`, `configs/example_h2_uccgd_pauli_protocol.yaml` |
| **ADAPT / IQEB pools** (`adapt_iqeb`) | Adaptive / IQEB operator-pool variational paths. | `configs/example_h2_adapt_singles_pool.yaml`, `configs/example_h2_iqeb_fermionic_doubles_pool.yaml` |
| **Excited states (VQD / QSE / SCEOM)** (`excited_states`) | Post-variational excited-state stages with shot accounting. | `configs/example_h2_vqd_uccsd.yaml`, `configs/example_h2_excited_smoke.yaml` |
| **Embedding / DMET / projection** (`embedding_dmet`) | Schmidt, DMET self-consistency, Mulliken projection traces. | `configs/example_h4_dmet_self_consistent.yaml`, `configs/example_h4_projection_mulliken.yaml` |
| **Mitigation + shot paths** (`mitigation_shots`) | ZNE fold, Qiskit bitstring Pauli, classical shadows. | `configs/example_h2_zne_qiskit_fold.yaml`, `configs/example_h2_qiskit_shots.yaml` |
| **QPE / fault-tolerant demo** (`qpe_ft`) | Main-config QPE and dual-track demo YAMLs. | `configs/example_h2_qpe_main.yaml`, `configs/qpe_dual_track_demo.yaml` |
| **MD / ML active learning** (`md_ml`) | QMEF dataset loops; optional QML-FF / UQC mock backends. | `configs/example_h2_qmlff_md.yaml`, `configs/example_h2_uqc_mock_md_ml.yaml` |

## CLI

```bash
qchem-run --list-scenarios
qchem-run configs/example_h2.yaml
```
